status.ready_no_hotkeys: Ready (global hotkeys unavailable on this system — buttons only)
status.recording_stopped_name_prompt: Recording stopped — enter a name and save
ui.recording_unavailable: ⚠ Keyboard and mouse capture is unavailable — recording will not work ({0}). On Linux this usually means a Wayland session: switch the input backend to evdev in ⚙ Settings (requires a build with the evdev feature and access to /dev/input/* and /dev/uinput, usually the input group), or run the app under X11/XWayland.
ui.recording_unavailable_evdev: ⚠ Keyboard and mouse capture is unavailable ({0}). The evdev backend is already selected — this is usually a permissions issue: add your user to the input group (sudo usermod -aG input $USER, then log out/in) and check access to /dev/uinput (some distros need a separate udev rule).
ui.screen_guard_warning: ⚠ Screen before step #{0} changed (distance {1}/64) — playback paused
settings.backend_restart_hint: Takes effect after restarting the app
settings.backend_wayland_hint: ⚠ Wayland session detected: rdevin cannot capture input here — switch to evdev
settings.backend_evdev_unavailable: This build has no evdev backend — rebuild with --features evdev
settings.hotkeys_portal_note: On pure Wayland, global hotkeys work via the system portal (build flag portal-hotkeys) after you grant permission
settings.hotkeys_unavailable: Global hotkeys are unavailable on this system
settings.allow_bare_hotkeys: Allow hotkeys without a modifier (bare key)
settings.allow_bare_hotkeys_warning: ⚠ For advanced users: a bare key as a global hotkey intercepts normal typing everywhere on the system, not just in this app
settings.error.parse_failed: Could not recognize the combo — needs at least one modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift) plus a key
settings.screen_guard_enabled: Check the screen before each click and pause on mismatch
settings.screen_guard_enabled_hint: Stores a perceptual hash of the click area; checked during playback
settings.save_thumbnails: Save click preview thumbnails for the step editor
settings.save_thumbnails_hint: ⚠ A real, if small, piece of the screen gets saved inside the macro file — keep that in mind when sharing/syncing macros
settings.screen_guard_unavailable: Screen guard unavailable: the app was built without the `screen-guard` feature (see README, "Build" section)
settings.compress_key_repeats_hint: On: holding a key is recorded as one step with total delay (compact, but a held Backspace replays as a single press). Off: every auto-repeat is a separate step (accurate, but macros grow).
step_editor.drag_hint: Drag a row with the mouse to reorder
step_editor.screenshot_hover: Screen around the click at the moment of recording
